derivation:
by
  change Function.Injective (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p]) : MvPolynomial (Fin 2 × ℕ) ℤ_[p] → _)
  exact MvPolynomial.map_injective _ (by intro x y h; simpa using h)
explanation: This specializes injectivity of polynomial coefficient maps to ℤ_[p] → ℚ_[p] and variables Fin 2 × ℕ. The coefficient-map injectivity side goal simplifies to subtype equality; incl is definitionally this polynomial map.
